name: Expository
prompts: Was the topic clear and interesting?

tags.label: Topic
tags.strength: You picked a topic that kept my interest.
tags.toWork: Narrow the topic so you can go deeper in the time.

tags.label: Clarity
tags.strength: You explained the topic in a way that was easy to understand.
tags.toWork: Explain the hard parts of the topic in simpler steps.

tags.label: Organization
tags.strength: Your points came in a clear order.
tags.toWork: Put your points in a clearer order, with a short preview.

tags.label: Delivery
tags.strength: Your voice and pace were easy to listen to.
tags.toWork: Vary your voice and pace so key lines stand out.

source: NSDA High School Unified Manual v2027.1.2, 2026-27 season. Summarized in our own words; no rule text copied.
